scope: A tab control taller than its tabs has them along its top edge, where 4D draws them; an invisible button nothing labels is not published.

evidence.before: With the previous centered placement, the container tab press failed: its tab was placed at the control's middle, over the Orders list, and the press was refused as overlapped.
evidence.hostApplication: an application's vendor window with the area: the column filter's tab was placed at form y 334.5 instead of the top edge (about 31); pressing Returns Info was refused as overlapped. With the fix, the press runs the application's column filter and the list's drawn titles change to Returns Contact and Returns Email.

regressions: tabs compiled VoiceOver :: PASS (an earlier attempt, and one with the previous build, could not capture VoiceOver's caption panel)
pacing: Presses queued before the previous press's result is published can expire under the bridge's stale-action guard; with presses 0.3, 0.6, 1 and 2 seconds apart, 1, 3, 4 and 4 of 4 were applied. Spacing the bridge's clicks beyond the double-click interval did not change this, so 4D's double-click handling is not the cause.
